ForgotPasswordDescription: To reset your password, please enter your registered email address below, and then click on the 'Reset Password' button. We'll send you an email with further instructions on how to regain access to your account.
DeleteAccountDescription: To securely delete your account, enter your password below. You will receive a confirmation email to complete the process. Please consider the permanence of this action, and feel free to reach out for assistance.
ContributionDescription:
Our project is open-source, which means we welcome contributions from the community. Whether you're a developer or a translator, your help is valuable.

Code Contributions: If you're a developer, you can contribute code by checking out our repository on SourceHut and submitting merge requests. We appreciate your technical expertise.

Translations: If you're interested in translations, you can help make the project accessible in different languages.

Thank you for considering contributing to 300sf. Your contributions help us grow and improve.
